title: How the Record-to-Record Comparator works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Record-to-Record Comparator does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach compares with a frozen field-weight table — the same record pair always yields the same change report and the same similarity score. Values are normalized by recorded rules before comparison (date formats, case, whitespace), and each normalization is logged so the comparison is auditable. Semantic near-matches consult the synonym ledger and are reported as likely-equivalent, never silently merged. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
